effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and aux.AddXyzProcedure require Level 4 Zombies, minimum three and maximum 99.

official_references.matched_structure: 3+ material Xyz procedure with a type/filter requirement.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn you can also Xyz Summon this card the turn 2 or more monsters have been Special Summoned from your Spell & Trap Zone by using a Zombie monster you control as material.
effects.lua_implementation: A global EVENT_SPSUMMON_SUCCESS tracker counts each card previously in LOCATION_SZONE for its summon player through End Phase. The alternate Xyz filter requires a face-up Zombie and count>=2; xyzop sets a turn oath flag to one alternative summon.

official_references.matched_structure: Once-per-turn alternate Xyz Summon using one archetype monster and transferring its materials.
Detects cards Special Summoned from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Transfers existing materials in an alternate/successive Xyz context.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Xyz Summoned: You can target 1 Zombie monster in your GY; place it in your Spell & Trap Zone.
effects.lua_implementation: The targeted Zombie is moved face-up from the GY to the Spell & Trap Zone without adding any Spell or Trap type-changing effect.

official_references.matched_structure: Places a monster into the Spell & Trap Zone and assigns a continuous card type.
Places a GY monster in the Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: unlike adjacent Crewal clauses, this exact clause does not say 'as a Continuous Trap'. Official Crystal Beast placement establishes MoveToField as the placement primitive and adds type only when the text does.

effects.printed_clause: Gains 1000 ATK for each Monster Card in your Spell & Trap Zone.
effects.lua_implementation: A single-range EFFECT_UPDATE_ATTACK counts face-up cards in the controller's Spell & Trap Zone whose original type includes Monster and returns count*1000.

official_references.matched_structure: Continuous ATK gain per continuous/qualified card in the Spell & Trap Zone.

effects.printed_clause: Your opponent cannot target this card for attacks or with card effects.
effects.lua_implementation: The handler receives EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_BATTLE_TARGET value 1 and EFFECT_CANNOT_BE_EFFECT_TARGET with aux.tgoval.

official_references.matched_structure: Card-effect target protection plus battle-target rules.

effects.printed_clause: During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 monster from your Spell & Trap Zone.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect checks the opponent is turn player, then Special Summons any face-up original Monster Card from the controller's Spell & Trap Zone.

official_references.matched_structure: Special Summons a Monster Card from the Spell & Trap Zone.
Face-up Monster Card in a Spell & Trap Zone as the operation subject.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Crewal Cursed Sea once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The Xyz-Summon placement and opponent-turn Quick Effect use id and id+100 hard once-per-turn keys; the alternate Xyz procedure has its own once-per-turn flag.

official_references.matched_structure: Separate once-per-turn alternate Xyz procedure and activated effect limits.

coverage_override.reason: Seven records cover materials, alternate Xyz procedure, GY placement, ATK gain, two targeting protections, opponent-turn summon, and HOPT as segmented in the audit.
